verdict.rationale: First-party docs and llms.txt state that Caveman and its CLI are open source, and community comments refer to a public repo that users starred. However, no specific open license is named or linked. One commenter also notes the repo contains a binary caveman.skill file that is not easily readable, which limits how fully the source can be read. missing for 10: named open-source license (e.g., MIT/Apache) with a license-file link, direct repository URL, evidence that all components (including the .skill artifact and Cloud) are readable source, independent confirmation of licensing terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: The open-source Caveman CLI wraps supported agents including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI.
The open-source CLI, shorter replies and context compression work without one.
